short: Software that keeps working when the internet does not.
seoTitle: Offline Mode — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: Offline mode lets software keep working without an internet connection, storing data locally and syncing when connectivity returns.
definition: Offline mode lets software keep working without an internet connection, storing data locally and syncing when connectivity returns. For billing, it is the difference between a slow evening and a stopped one.
bodyHtml:
Why Offline Mode matters

Internet outages are routine in Indian markets and basements, and they arrive during peak hours. Billing that depends on a live connection stops the business exactly when it is busiest.

How Offline Mode works in practice

Test it properly: turn off the connection during a quiet hour and complete a full billing cycle. Also confirm what happens on reconnection, since sync conflicts are where offline systems actually fail.

faq.question: Is offline billing legal for GST?
faq.answer: Yes. What matters is the invoice content and record-keeping, not whether the device was online — though e-invoicing, where applicable, needs connectivity to register.

faq.question: What happens to data when offline?
faq.answer: It is stored on the device and synced later, which is why backup and export matter.
